header: A measured result and what caused it
lead: A large figure, its unit beside it and one line of text below. That line matters most, because it names the feature behind the number.
note: If the figures are properties to look up rather than results, use the spec sheet.

metrics.title: Entries per element
metrics.text: With more than six, the figures are hard to remember and read like a table.

metrics.title: Tabular numerals
metrics.text: Every digit has the same width, so the figures in a row line up.

metrics.title: The feature behind it
metrics.text: This line is the difference from a plain statistics row.
